def full_projection_gradient(
    parameter: torch.nn.Parameter,
    d_model: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    full_grad = torch.cat(
        (
            parameter.grad.new_zeros(3),
            parameter.grad,
            parameter.grad.new_zeros(d_model),
        )
    ).view(d_model, d_model)
    full_grad[-1] = -full_grad[:-1].sum(dim=0)
    return full_grad
